string.text: A compact backpack-mounted organiser for ordinary and Zone-produced food and drinks. Holds four unstacked items in a 2x2 grid. Mutant meat and trophies belong in a Hunter's Kit.
A backpack-mounted organiser for ordinary and Zone-produced food and drinks. Holds six unstacked items in a 2x3 grid. Crafted by upgrading an empty Small sustainment pouch.
A large backpack-mounted organiser for ordinary and Zone-produced food and drinks. Holds eight unstacked items in a 2x4 grid. Crafted by upgrading an empty Sustainment pouch.
